acceptance_criteria: Fields moved to Participant. cargo test --workspace exits 0.
close_reason: Removed schedule_sequence/schedule_updated from CalendarEvent and backend.rs CalendarEventProperty; added both to Participant in jscalendar.rs per RFC 8984 §5.2 Context:Participant; added two round-trip tests
description:
**What:** Correct a spec conformance error. RFC 8984 §5.2.1 (scheduleSequence) and §5.2.2 (scheduleUpdated) define these properties with Context: Participant, not CalendarEvent. Currently they are top-level fields on CalendarEvent in event.rs; they must be moved to the Participant struct in jscalendar.rs.

**Algorithm:**
1. Verify with grep that no downstream crate in the workspace accesses schedule_sequence or schedule_updated on CalendarEvent directly.
2. Remove schedule_sequence and schedule_updated from CalendarEvent in event.rs.
3. Remove ScheduleSequence and ScheduleUpdated variants from CalendarEventProperty in backend.rs.
4. Add to Participant in jscalendar.rs:
   #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
   pub schedule_sequence: Option<u64>,    // RFC 8984 §5.2.1; wire: scheduleSequence
   #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
   pub schedule_updated: Option<String>,  // RFC 8984 §5.2.2; wire: scheduleUpdated; UTCDateTime
5. Add round-trip serde test for Participant with both fields set.
6. Run cargo test --workspace.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- Participant has schedule_sequence and schedule_updated.
- CalendarEvent does NOT have these fields.
- CalendarEventProperty does NOT have ScheduleSequence or ScheduleUpdated.
- Wire names on Participant: scheduleSequence, scheduleUpdated.
- cargo test --workspace exits 0. Clippy clean.
title: Fix scheduleSequence/scheduleUpdated: move from CalendarEvent to Participant
